studentIncentives.label: On-campus residence accommodation for registered full-time students
studentIncentives.detail: Apply online via the Residential Management System after academic registration. Places are limited and not guaranteed — priority is given to new students and those from faraway places.

studentIncentives.label: Tuition fee payment plan available

groups.note: Business, humanities, education, law, and most other undergraduate faculties.

feeSchedule.audienceNote: Resident and SADC/African student rates. International and non-resident rates are higher — see the official schedule.
feeSchedule.description: UB charges tuition per credit. Multiply your registered credits each semester by the faculty rate below. A normal full-time undergraduate load is 30 credits per semester.

name: BIUST
description: Botswana International University of Science and Technology — STEM-focused university in Palapye with new schools in pure and applied sciences, engineering, earth sciences, and life sciences.

studentIncentives.label: On-campus student accommodation
studentIncentives.detail: BIUST provides student housing on campus. Contact Student Affairs for availability and application deadlines.

name: Botswana School of Business Sciences
description: Formerly Botswana Accountancy College (BAC): a multi-disciplinary institution offering business, finance, computing, hospitality, logistics, and insurance, with campuses in Gaborone and Francistown. Undergraduate qualifications are NCQF-aligned and BQA-accredited; from 2026/27 newly admitted undergraduates are awarded by BSBS, while continuing students complete under existing partnership arrangements. Postgraduate awards remain on existing collaborative routes.

studentIncentives.label: Flexible tuition payment options
studentIncentives.detail: BSBS offers instalment plans for self-sponsored students — confirm current terms with the finance office.

name: Botho University
description: Large private university with broad undergraduate and postgraduate offerings in business, health, computing, education, and the social sciences.

studentIncentives.label: Student accommodation at Gaborone and Francistown campuses
studentIncentives.detail: Botho University offers on-campus housing. Enquire with the student affairs office for availability and fees.

groups.name: Engineering
groups.note: All engineering programmes (campus learning). 600 credits over 5 years ≈ P360,000 total at current rates.

groups.name: General programmes
groups.note: Business, health, education, computing, law, and most other undergraduate faculties.

feeSchedule.audienceNote: Botswana campus learning rates for citizens and residents. Online campus uses USD per-credit rates.
feeSchedule.description: Botho uses a pay-as-you-learn credit model. Each module has a credit value (often 10 or 20). Tuition = credits registered × fee per credit. A normal full-time semester is 60 credits.
